entries.bad_example: for i in $(cat list.txt); do ... done
entries.good_example:
while IFS= read -r line; do
    ...
done < list.txt
entries.rationale: The $(...) syntax spawns subshells and consumes massive memory for large files. Reading line-by-line via stream redirection is efficient.
External binary calls (cut, sed, awk) are slow inside loops. SS QLM prioritizes parameter expansion for high-speed string manipulation.
